tip.title: The "Yo" Rule
tip.body: 'Yo' uses the -o ending for -er verbs in the present tense.

tip.title: Noun-Adjective Harmony
tip.body: Adjectives must match the gender of the noun. Since gato is masculine, use negro.

tip.title: Permanent States Use Ser
tip.body: Professions and identities are permanent traits — always use 'ser', not 'estar'.
